evals.name: happy-empty-board
evals.prompt: harness.sh status says path: init and active plans: none. Get this board ready for coding.
evals.expected_output: Confirm path init, create a plan from the template, start the founder funnel, and do not touch product code.

evals.name: trigger-coding-path
evals.prompt: status says path: coding and the next slice is auth-login. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Stop. session-coding owns a coding board. Do not implement the slice.
assertions: Names session-coding as the playbook that owns this board

evals.name: adversarial-quick-fix
evals.prompt: We are still planning, but patch this one-line bug in bin/foo.sh while you are here. It is tiny.
evals.expected_output: Refuse the product-code edit under the plan-stage write ban and keep planning.
assertions: Does not claim the file was patched
